info.name: Public API
info.description:
API for external systems to integrate with Twind using public API keys.
Additional products may extend this document over time.

## Authentication

Use the `X-Api-Key` header with your public API key.

item.name: Shared
item.description:
Shared endpoints for who is calling the API, which companies apply, and common lists used to filter other operations.

- **Me**: Current user and permissions for the API key
- **User companies**: Companies visible to the authenticated user
- **Company details**: Get full company details (members only)
- **Company summary**: Get a summary of any company by id (any authenticated user)
- **Contractors with active contracts**: List contractors associated with a client company (my-contractors)
- **Countries**: List countries
- **Sites**: List sites for a company
- **Activities**: List company activities
- **Assigned resources**: Resources assigned to contracts (client view)
- **Assigned resources (contractor)**: Resources assigned to contracts (contractor view)
- **Clients**: Client companies for a contractor
- **Users**: List users for a company
- **Employees**: List employees for a company
- **Vehicles**: List vehicles for a company
- **Equipment**: List equipment for a company
- **Contracts (as contractor)**: List contracts where the company acts as contractor
- **Contract engagements**: List engagements for a contract

item.name: Access control
item.description:
Track people and assets on site: register access and visits, query authorization status, and issue access cards.

- **Visitors**: List, create, read, and update visitor records; presigned upload URL; plate numbers and visitor companies
- **Visit register**: List and create visits; read and update a visit record
- **Access register**: List and create access entries; record exit; read entry by id
- **Access control (status)**: Read access control row by id; list as contractor or as client
- **Access card**: Download access card file (PDF or PNG) for a resource
- **Temporary authorizations**: List, create, read, update, and delete; search names and authorizers

item.name: Requirements
item.description:
Configure contract requirements, inspect requirement instances, and submit or review evidence against them.

- **Requirement (detail)**: Get and update a requirement configuration
- **Requirements (list)**: List and create requirements
- **Requirement template upload**: Presigned URL to upload a requirement template file
- **Requirement stats**: Statistics for a requirement
- **Requirement enable/disable**: Enable or disable a requirement for a company
- **Requirement instance**: Get a requirement instance
- **Requirement instance logs**: List change logs for an instance
- **Eligible resources**: List resources eligible for an instance
- **Requirement instances (contractor)**: List instances and contractor requirement index
- **Requirement instances (client)**: List instances for the client company
- **Evidence file upload URL**: Presigned URL for evidence file upload
- **Evidence agreement**: Submit agreement-type evidence
- **Evidence (read/update)**: Get or update an evidence record
- **Evidence approve**: Approve evidence
- **Evidence reject**: Reject evidence
- **Evidence matching**: Match submitted evidence to requirement instances
